text:
Ava: quick think-piece for the team — if the office vending machine could be reprogrammed to stock one single item for free forever (for everyone), what would you pick? rules: one item, realistic-ish, no cash.

Maya: single-serve cold brew cans. energy + joy. :coffee:

Devon: portable phone chargers (the little battery bricks). offices + airports = chaos saver.

Samir: high-quality earbuds. noise-cancelling would be a stretch but even basic ones would be gold.

Jules: canned sparkling water. hydration + fancier than plain tap, low fuss. :sparkles:

Maya: also vote for salted caramel protein bars — morale at 3pm.

Devon: @Maya that sounds like a very specific hill to die on :joy: but fair.

Ava: love these. think about fairness — chargers/earbuds could go missing tho. maybe single-use items make more sense?

Samir: ops-bot chiming in: "Reminder: the vending machine can’t legally dispense medical devices." :robot_face:

Jules: micro-poll: reactions only — :coffee: for cold brew, :battery: for chargers, :headphones: for earbuds, :sparkles: for sparkling water, :chocolate_bar: for protein bars

Devon: (adds :battery:)

Maya: (adds :coffee:)

Samir: (adds :sparkles:)

Ava: (adds :headphones:)

Jules: thanks y’all — tally looks close but cold brew + chargers are winning. small victory for collective caffeine/juice supply chain.

Maya: follow-up: if we actually did this, would anyone steal the whole vending machine? just curious.

Devon: yes but only on Tuesdays.

Ava: thread closed unless someone wants to lobby facilities for free-sparkling-water day. :handshake:
